title: The Shelter of Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi ‘l-hamd!
O our Lord! Forgive us and blessing us. We are weak servants, and we are needy as whole creatures are in
need of Your blessings. O our Lord! Forgive us, and let us to try to make You pleased with us. We know that
You are going to be pleased when we are giving our most respect and salutes on Your best and most honored
one through Your Divine Presence; then may be Your beloved one’s blessings on the Children of Adam.
Please forgive us!
(Mawlana shaykh sits.)
Allah, Allah. Whole praisings and glory first for our Lord, our Creator, and then on His most honored one
through the Divine Presence. Then we are asking from Your endless Mercy Oceans for this holy month to run
on Your weak servants. We are in need of heavenly support. Therefore, I am calling our master who is in
charge for keeping this planet on its own final limit, yes. And we are saying a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani
‘r-rajeem. We are running from every wrong thinking and from every wrong understandings, not to make our
Lord unhappy with us. Therefore, we are asking humbly a protection from Sadanas’ tricks and traps, not to
fall through Sadanas’ sewage channels because Sadanas only calling people to those dirty channels.

And we are saying a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani ‘r-rajeem. O our Lord! Give us Your heavenly protection
through Your most beloved one through Your Divine Presence! Then heavenly announcement coming to
people when they are saying a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani ‘r-rajeem, that we are running to You, O our
Lord, from Sadanas and its tricks and traps.
There is coming an announcement from heavens, so many announcements coming, but Man is not taking any
care to keep that wasaya (advice) that our Lord granting us from His heavenly levels to protect His deputies
on Earth. That announcement coming and saying bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem. Who is asking a
protection from Sadanas and its tricks, trips and traps may use this heavenly sword that granted to you, O
Nation of Muhammad (s)! Let them say bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem, that protects them. Therefore,
everything that we are intending to do, or to make, and we are asking efforts to be granted to ourselves, we
must say bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem. When you are saying bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem no any
permission for Sadanas (Satan) and its followers to harm you. That is a heavenly shelter for Mankind. When
they are fearing from anything, they may say bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem then they are going to be
protected and sheltered.
It is a big blame for believers to fear from a virus named by scientists and doctors as the “pig flu”. Big blame!
They must be ashamed! They are fearing from the pig flu, from that virus that they can’t see it and never
saying that virus, “I am pig virus, pig flu!” Never claiming that, “I can kill you!” The blame is to Mankind, to
fear from pig flu! Where is Allah? Where is its Creator? Why you are not fearing from the Creator that created
you, as well as created everything and through them that virus? You are not seeing, not touching, even you
are not feeling, but you are giving such a name for that virus! Yes, even though may be that virus created by
its Creator—because nothing can be in existence without the Creator’s creating—He must ask to be created
such a virus as a punishment of Mankind, that their steps are wrong steps. Whole Mankind now living on this
planet, they are on wrong steps.
Allah Almighty is saying go in this direction, that is safety for you. They are saying, “No, we must go back.”
That is our ego’s characteristic. When the Lord of Heavens created our egos, nafs, He said to the ego, “Come!”
and he (ego) was going back and the Lord of Heavens was saying, “Go!” and he (ego) is coming back. That is
the characteristic of our egos: always they are asking to be what they are saying, and not what the Lord of

Heavens, our Creator, saying! Egos are fighting Allah. That means it is doing always what it is asking, never
asking to follow its Creator’s command. When they are coming in existence, going to be enemies for their
Creator (because) what He is saying, making contrary.
Therefore, now peoples’ egos are saying to them, “Oh, this virus is very terrible and dangerous.” Put the Holy
Qur’an and say bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem, and Fatihah as biggest disinfectant; finished! But you are
bringing so many dirty principles you are inventing and putting in front of boys, and then you are fearing
from virus flu and pig flu. If they are not taking care, taking their high respect for their Lord, may come dogs
flu! Pigs living outside, but if coming dog flu that so many people may be kissing them, laying with them,
eating with them, one (bite of food) for (their) dog, one for his owner’s mouth, very dangerous! If coming that
flu, it is going to be seven times more terrible than pig flu!
O People! Come and listen. Allah Almighty created you to be His servants and you are leaving that
servanthood. Civilized Europeans, civilized western people, for what they are (called) civilization? They are
servants of their dogs; 24 hours they are serving their dogs. Everything, every care (they are) taking for dogs
and morning walking and once again evening walking for them. And they are speaking with their dogs, “O my
darling, are you happy with me?”
(Mawlana Shaykh stands, upset.) What is this foolishness!? What is this civilization?! Allah created those
people to be dogs' servants or for His servanthood??! What is that??! What is that?! Allah is unhappy with
those who are keeping dogs (in their homes)! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
(He) may do, the Lord of Heavens, because dogs are from wild animals, running, hunting and eating meat.
They are so wild, eating meat and bones also. Be fearful, whole Mankind! Particularly ...beware. Maybe one
night that dogs are sleeping with you they may attack you on your throat, biting you, and killing you, may be!
Because you are living a life that everything is possible and it is so possible, so easy, for the Creator to change
dogs to be a jackal or a wolf and attacking its owner, biting and even killing (their owners). (Jackals, wolves
and wild dogs may even) drink the blood; even eat the flesh, and even eat the bones.
Beware! I am not speaking on behalf of me, but I am a warner to all nations! Don’t keep dogs (inside your
homes)! Don’t be servants for dogs, but try to be your Lord’s servants, or divinely anger may come, so mighty,
so strongly! Don’t waste your life to be servants of dogs! Your honor is to be your Lord’s servants. (This is a

divine) warning.
And one word I was speaking on, I was saying as-salaamu `alaykum - peace be upon you - O our listeners!
That salaam (greeting) is a main pillar for protecting people from evil and devils. Keep what is written
through the Old Testament, New Testament and in the Holy Qur’an. Understanding? If not understanding,
one day you can understand, but as English people saying, “It should be too late, too late.” Don’t wait to be
said for you, “too late”! Because your Lord’s anger, if coming, no one can take it away, making you like earth
or like dust.
I am not taking a salary, no salary for Man. I am a weak servant that our Grand Ones, that they have Grand
Ones, means holy ones, who they are trying to keep their oath with their Lord. O our Lord, we are accepting
that You are our Creator and we are Your servants, never changing!
O People! Leave dogs (to themselves). Leave dogs or they should bite you. If biting, no any medicine.
(Transmission failed)
